```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  cache = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 4.8,
  fig.pos = "H"
)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Save results in the Weed Biomass folder.
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Weed Biomass")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Confirmed mowing schedule relative to broccoli transplanting:
# T2: 1 week before, and 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting.
# T3: 1 week before, and 6 weeks after transplanting.
# T4: 1 week before transplanting only.
#
# Treatments remain categorical factors in the statistical model.

treatment_levels <- c("T4", "T3", "T2")

treatment_labels <- c(
  T4 = "T4\n-1 week",
  T3 = "T3\n-1 and +6 weeks",
  T2 = "T2\n-1, +3 and +6 weeks"
)

treatment_colours <- c(
  T4 = "#A56A46",
  T3 = "#4B8395",
  T2 = "#4A8862"
)

locations <- c("Broccoli", "Cover crop")

save_csv <- function(x, filename) {
  write.csv(
    x,
    file.path(output_dir, filename),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
}

show_table <- function(x, caption, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n\n")

  print(knitr::kable(
    x,
    caption = caption,
    digits = digits,
    row.names = FALSE
  ))

  cat("\n\n")
}

make_anova_table <- function(model) {
  a <- as.data.frame(anova(model))

  data.frame(
    Term = rownames(a),
    a,
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Research question

Does mowing treatment affect total recorded vegetation biomass
at broccoli harvest?

All three treatments were mown one week before broccoli transplanting.
Additional mowing followed the treatment-specific schedule:

- **T2:** mown at 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting,
  giving three mowing events in total.
- **T3:** mown at 6 weeks after transplanting,
  giving two mowing events in total.
- **T4:** no additional mowing after transplanting,
  giving one mowing event in total.

The analysis compares T2, T3, and T4 in four blocks.

All recorded species are included, including clovers and unidentified
taxa. The response is therefore total vegetation biomass.

## Sampling and statistical methods

The two sampling locations are analysed separately:

- **Broccoli:** quadrat area of 0.28 square metres; vegetation cut
  at ground level.
- **Cover crop:** quadrat area of 0.16 square metres; vegetation cut
  at 8 cm above ground.

Recorded masses are summed within each quadrat and divided by
quadrat area. The two quadrat densities are then averaged within
each plot and sampling location.

The plot is the experimental unit. Each sampling location contains
12 plot means: three treatments in four blocks.

For each location, the model is:

\[
\mathrm{Biomass}_{ij}
=
\mu + \mathrm{Treatment}_i + \mathrm{Block}_j
+ \varepsilon_{ij}.
\]

Treatment and block are fitted as categorical effects.
Tukey adjustment is applied to the three pairwise treatment
comparisons within each sampling location.

## Import and prepare the data

```{r import-and-clean, include=FALSE}
# Output folder.
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Weed Biomass")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Treatment order, labels and colours.
treatment_levels <- c("T1", "T4", "T3", "T2")

treatment_labels <- c(
  T1 = "T1\nWeedy control",
  T4 = "T4\n-1 week",
  T3 = "T3\n-1 and +6 weeks",
  T2 = "T2\n-1, +3 and +6 weeks"
)

treatment_colours <- c(
  T1 = "#777777",
  T4 = "#A56A46",
  T3 = "#4B8395",
  T2 = "#4A8862"
)

locations <- c("Broccoli", "Cover crop")

# Download the workbook from GitHub: 2-Data/Raw/.
github_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pr1nc3sso/",
  "Xilei-Living-cover-crop/master/2-Data/Raw/",
  "Vegetation%20survey%20-%20broccoli%20harvest.xlsx"
)

options(timeout = max(120, getOption("timeout", 60)))
excel_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")

download.file(
  github_url,
  excel_file,
  mode = "wb",
  method = "libcurl",
  quiet = TRUE
)

raw <- read_excel(
  excel_file,
  sheet = "2026",
  range = cell_cols("A:J"),
  col_types = "text",
  trim_ws = FALSE
)

expected_headers <- c(
  "Biomass collection date",
  "Weeks after transplanting",
  "Block",
  "Treatment",
  "Quadrat",
  "Relative location to Broccoli: in row or in cover crop",
  "Species",
  "Biomass weight without bags, scale tared (gram)",
  "Quadrat size (m2)",
  "Weight date"
)

if (!identical(names(raw), expected_headers)) {
  stop("Excel headers changed. Check the column mapping.")
}

# Preserve source row numbers.
raw$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(raw)) + 1L
raw <- raw[rowSums(!is.na(raw[1:10])) > 0, ]

# Remove only exact duplicates across the original ten columns.
duplicate_flag <- duplicated(as.data.frame(raw[1:10]))

save_csv(
  raw[duplicate_flag, ],
  "removed_exact_duplicates.csv"
)

clean <- raw[!duplicate_flag, ]

names(clean)[1:10] <- c(
  "collection_date",
  "weeks_after_transplanting",
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "quadrat",
  "location",
  "species",
  "weight_g",
  "source_area_m2",
  "weighing_date"
)

clean <- clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(block, treatment, quadrat, weight_g, source_area_m2),
      as.numeric
    ),
    source_location = location,
    source_species = species,
    location = trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", location)),
    species = toupper(trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", species))),
    species = recode(
      species,
      "UNKNOWNN MONOCOTS" = "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS",
      "UNKNOWNN DICOTS" = "UNKNOWN DICOTS"
    ),
    # All T1 quadrats follow the cover-crop-area sampling protocol.
    location = if_else(treatment == 1, "Cover crop", location)
  )

# Validate identifiers and weights.
numeric_fields <- c(
  "block", "treatment", "quadrat", "weight_g"
)

if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(clean[numeric_fields])))) {
  stop("Missing or invalid identifiers or weights.")
}

if (any(clean$weight_g < 0)) {
  stop("Negative biomass weights.")
}

if (
  any(!clean$block %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$treatment %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$quadrat %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$location %in% locations)
) {
  stop("Unexpected block, treatment, quadrat or location.")
}

if (any(is.na(clean$species) | clean$species == "")) {
  stop("Missing species labels.")
}

# Explicit classification of the currently recorded weed codes.
weed_species <- c(
  "AMARE", "ARTVU", "CAPBP", "CHEAL", "DIGIS", "DIGSA",
  "ECHCG", "GASCI", "LACSE", "MALNE", "MEDLU", "OXASD",
  "OXAST", "PLANA", "POLLA", "POLPE", "POROL", "SETSP",
  "SETPU", "SETVI", "TRFRE", "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS"
)

analysis_records <- clean %>%
  mutate(
    # T1 has already been assigned to the Cover crop protocol.
    area_m2 = if_else(location == "Broccoli", 0.28, 0.16),
    component = case_when(
      species == "TRFAL" ~ "Sown cover crop",
      species == "CLOVER" ~ "Legacy clover",
      species %in% c("UNKNOWN BRASSICA", "UNKNOWN DICOTS") ~
        "Unclassified",
      species %in% weed_species ~ "Weeds",
      TRUE ~ "Unmapped"
    )
  )

save_csv(
  analysis_records %>%
    distinct(source_species, species, component),
  "species_classification.csv"
)

# New codes must be checked rather than automatically called weeds.
if (any(analysis_records$component == "Unmapped")) {
  save_csv(
    filter(analysis_records, component == "Unmapped"),
    "unmapped_species.csv"
  )
  stop("New species codes found. Check unmapped_species.csv.")
}

save_csv(
  analysis_records,
  "clean_T1_T4_records.csv"
)

save_csv(
  analysis_records %>%
    filter(
      is.na(source_area_m2) |
        abs(source_area_m2 - area_m2) > 1e-10 |
        is.na(source_location) |
        source_location != location
    ),
  "sampling_corrections.csv"
)

save_csv(
  filter(analysis_records, component == "Unclassified"),
  "unclassified_records.csv"
)

# Avoid combining different collection dates within a quadrat.
date_check <- analysis_records %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates = n_distinct(collection_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(date_check$n_dates != 1L)) {
  stop("Missing or multiple collection dates within quadrats.")
}

# Aggregate all observed quadrats before selecting biomass components.
quadrat_data <- analysis_records %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat) %>%
  summarise(
    area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    confirmed_weed_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Weeds"]),
    legacy_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Legacy clover"]),
    unclassified_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Unclassified"]),
    n_berseem_records = sum(component == "Sown cover crop"),
    berseem_g = if (any(component == "Sown cover crop")) {
      sum(weight_g[component == "Sown cover crop"])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    recorded_total_g = sum(weight_g),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    confirmed_weed_g_m2 = confirmed_weed_g / area_m2,
    legacy_g_m2 = legacy_g / area_m2,
    unclassified_g_m2 = unclassified_g / area_m2,

    # Primary response includes legacy clover.
    weed_g_m2 = (confirmed_weed_g + legacy_g) / area_m2,

    # Classification sensitivity includes unclassified vegetation.
    inclusive_g_m2 = weed_g_m2 + unclassified_g_m2,

    # Missing cover-crop records remain NA.
    recorded_berseem_g_m2 = berseem_g / area_m2,
    recorded_total_g_m2 = recorded_total_g / area_m2
  )

# Expected layout:
# T1: 4 blocks x 4 quadrats = 16.
# T2-T4: 4 blocks x 3 treatments x 2 locations x 2 quadrats = 48.
expected_quadrats <- bind_rows(
  expand_grid(
    block = 1:4,
    treatment = 1,
    location = "Cover crop",
    quadrat = 1:4
  ),
  expand_grid(
    block = 1:4,
    treatment = 2:4,
    location = locations,
    quadrat = 1:2
  )
)

keys <- c("block", "treatment", "location", "quadrat")

missing_quadrats <- anti_join(
  expected_quadrats,
  quadrat_data,
  by = keys
)

unexpected_quadrats <- anti_join(
  quadrat_data,
  expected_quadrats,
  by = keys
)

save_csv(missing_quadrats, "missing_quadrats.csv")
save_csv(unexpected_quadrats, "unexpected_quadrats.csv")

if (
  nrow(missing_quadrats) > 0 ||
  nrow(unexpected_quadrats) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "Check the quadrat audit files. ",
    "Do not replace missing quadrats with zero."
  )
}

# One mean per experimental plot and sampling location.
plot_data <- quadrat_data %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location) %>%
  summarise(
    n_quadrats = n(),
    across(
      c(
        confirmed_weed_g_m2,
        legacy_g_m2,
        unclassified_g_m2,
        weed_g_m2,
        inclusive_g_m2,
        recorded_total_g_m2
      ),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = factor(
      paste0("B", block),
      levels = paste0("B", 1:4)
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      paste0("T", treatment),
      levels = treatment_levels
    )
  )

if (
  any(
    plot_data$n_quadrats !=
      ifelse(plot_data$treatment == "T1", 4L, 2L)
  )
) {
  stop("Expected four quadrats for T1 and two per location for T2-T4.")
}

save_csv(
  quadrat_data,
  "quadrat_biomass_components.csv"
)

save_csv(
  plot_data,
  "plot_biomass_components.csv"
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Source:", github_url),
    paste(
      "Downloaded at UTC:",
      format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC")
    ),
    paste(
      "Workbook MD5:",
      unname(tools::md5sum(excel_file))
    ),
    "T1: no broccoli or cover crop planted; four 0.16 m2 quadrats per block; cut at 8 cm.",
    "T2: mowing at -1, +3 and +6 weeks relative to transplanting.",
    "T3: mowing at -1 and +6 weeks. T4: mowing at -1 week.",
    "Primary weeds include legacy CLOVER; unclassified vegetation is excluded.",
    "Classification sensitivity includes unclassified vegetation.",
    "Rye biomass was not recorded. Missing cover-crop records are not zeros."
  ),
  file.path(output_dir, "data_source.txt")
)
```

## Sampling checks

T1 has four quadrats per block, sampled at 8 cm above ground.
T2-T4 have two quadrats per plot and sampling location.
Each plot contributes one mean to its location-specific analysis.

```{r sampling-checks}
sampling_check <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(location, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Plots = n(),
    Quadrats = sum(n_quadrats),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  sampling_check,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Fit the weed models and prepare figures

```{r models-and-figures, include=FALSE}
fit_tables <- function(d, response) {
  fit <- lm(
    reformulate(
      c("treatment", "block"),
      response = response
    ),
    data = d,
    na.action = na.fail
  )

  emm <- emmeans(
    fit,
    ~ treatment,
    weights = "equal"
  )

  list(
    fit = fit,
    anova = make_anova_table(fit),
    means = as.data.frame(
      confint(emm, level = 0.95)
    ),
    tukey = as.data.frame(
      summary(
        pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"),
        infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    )
  )
}

analyse_location <- function(location_name) {
  d <- droplevels(
    filter(plot_data, location == location_name)
  )

  expected_n <- if (location_name == "Broccoli") {
    12L
  } else {
    16L
  }

  if (
    nrow(d) != expected_n ||
    !all(table(d$block, d$treatment) == 1L)
  ) {
    stop("Expected one plot mean per block-treatment combination.")
  }

  primary <- fit_tables(d, "weed_g_m2")
  classification <- fit_tables(d, "inclusive_g_m2")

  log_result <- if (all(d$weed_g_m2 > 0)) {
    fit_tables(
      mutate(d, log_weed = log(weed_g_m2)),
      "log_weed"
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  a <- anova(primary$fit)
  pval <- a["treatment", "Pr(>F)"]

  ptext <- if (pval < 0.001) {
    "<0.001"
  } else {
    paste("=", sprintf("%.3f", pval))
  }

  caption_text <- if (location_name == "Broccoli") {
    paste(
      "T2-T4: cut at ground level; two quadrats per plot.",
      "T1 is reported separately."
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "All samples cut at 8 cm. T1: no broccoli or cover crop planted;",
      " four quadrats per plot.\n",
      "T2-T4: two quadrats per plot."
    )
  }

  figure <- ggplot(
    d,
    aes(treatment, weed_g_m2)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        colour = treatment,
        shape = block
      ),
      position = position_jitter(
        width = 0.06,
        height = 0,
        seed = 42
      ),
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = primary$means,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        ymin = emmean - SE,
        ymax = emmean + SE
      ),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = primary$means,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        y = emmean
      ),
      shape = 18,
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = treatment_labels
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = treatment_colours
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(16, 17, 15, 3)
    ) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Weed biomass:",
        location_name,
        "sampling area"
      ),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Treatment ANOVA: F(%d, %d) = %.2f; p %s",
        a["treatment", "Df"],
        df.residual(primary$fit),
        a["treatment", "F value"],
        ptext
      ),
      x = "Treatment and mowing weeks relative to transplanting",
      y = expression(
        "Weed biomass (g " * m^{-2} * ")"
      ),
      shape = "Block",
      caption = paste0(
        caption_text,
        "\nPoints: plots; diamonds: adjusted means;",
        " bars: +/- 1 model-based SE.",
        "\nWeeds include legacy clover;",
        " unclassified vegetation is excluded."
      )
    ) +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0,
        size = 8
      )
    )

  prefix <- tolower(
    gsub(" ", "_", location_name)
  )

  analyses <- list(
    primary = primary,
    classification = classification,
    log = log_result
  )

  for (nm in names(analyses)) {
    z <- analyses[[nm]]

    if (is.null(z)) next

    for (tab in c("anova", "means", "tukey")) {
      save_csv(
        z[[tab]],
        paste0(
          prefix, "_weed_", nm, "_", tab, ".csv"
        )
      )
    }
  }

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(prefix, "_weed_biomass.png")
    ),
    plot = figure,
    width = 8,
    height = 5.5,
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(prefix, "_weed_biomass.pdf")
    ),
    plot = figure,
    width = 8,
    height = 5.5,
    bg = "white"
  )

  list(
    location = location_name,
    primary = primary,
    classification = classification,
    log = log_result,
    figure = figure
  )
}

results <- setNames(
  lapply(locations, analyse_location),
  locations
)

format_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "",
    ifelse(
      x < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", x)
    )
  )
}

report_tables <- function(
  z,
  label,
  include_means = TRUE
) {
  a <- z$anova
  a[["Pr(>F)"]] <- format_p(a[["Pr(>F)"]])

  show_table(
    a,
    paste(label, "- ANOVA"),
    digits = 3
  )

  if (include_means) {
    show_table(
      select(
        z$means,
        treatment,
        emmean,
        SE,
        lower.CL,
        upper.CL
      ),
      paste(
        label,
        "- adjusted means, SEs and individual 95% CIs"
      ),
      digits = 2
    )
  }

  t <- z$tukey %>%
    select(
      contrast,
      estimate,
      SE,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      p.value
    )

  t$p.value <- format_p(t$p.value)

  show_table(
    t,
    paste(label, "- Tukey-adjusted comparisons"),
    digits = 3
  )
}
```

## Broccoli sampling area: weed biomass

The model compares T2-T4 using samples cut at ground level.
T1 was sampled at 8 cm and is shown separately below as a reference.

```{r broccoli-results, results='asis'}
report_tables(
  results[["Broccoli"]]$primary,
  "Broccoli area"
)

print(results[["Broccoli"]]$figure)
```

### T1 reference: no broccoli or cover crop planted

These are the same T1 plots used in the cover-crop-area analysis.
They are not additional replicates and are not included in the
Broccoli-area ANOVA or its Tukey comparisons.

The summary below is a descriptive mean and SE across four blocks,
not a marginal mean from the Broccoli-area model.

```{r t1-reference}
t1_reference <- plot_data %>%
  filter(treatment == "T1") %>%
  select(
    block,
    n_quadrats,
    weed_g_m2
  )

t1_summary <- t1_reference %>%
  summarise(
    Blocks = n(),
    Mean_g_m2 = mean(weed_g_m2),
    SE_g_m2 = sd(weed_g_m2) / sqrt(n())
  )

knitr::kable(
  t1_reference,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  t1_summary,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE
)

save_csv(
  t1_reference,
  "T1_reference_plot_weed_biomass.csv"
)

save_csv(
  t1_summary,
  "T1_reference_descriptive_summary.csv"
)
```

## Cover-crop sampling area: weed biomass

The model compares T1-T4. T1 is the weedy control with no broccoli
or cover crop planted. All included samples were cut at 8 cm.

```{r cover-crop-results, results='asis'}
report_tables(
  results[["Cover crop"]]$primary,
  "Cover-crop area"
)

print(results[["Cover crop"]]$figure)
```

Figure error bars are +/- 1 model-based SE.
The tables retain individual 95% confidence intervals for means
and Tukey-adjusted 95% confidence intervals for pairwise differences.

## Recorded cover-crop biomass

Only TRFAL is classified as the current sown cover crop.
Rye weight was not recorded.

The table shows recorded berseem biomass in quadrats where a TRFAL
record exists. Missing records are not treated as zeros, and these
data are not presented as complete cover-crop biomass.

The current sparse records are reported descriptively without
a cover-crop ANOVA.

```{r recorded-cover-crop}
cc_records <- quadrat_data %>%
  filter(n_berseem_records > 0) %>%
  transmute(
    Block = paste0("B", block),
    Treatment = paste0("T", treatment),
    Location = location,
    Quadrat = quadrat,
    Area_m2 = area_m2,
    Weight_g = berseem_g,
    Biomass_g_m2 = recorded_berseem_g_m2
  )

knitr::kable(
  cc_records,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Recorded berseem biomass"
)

save_csv(
  cc_records,
  "recorded_berseem_biomass.csv"
)
```

## Legacy clover and unclassified vegetation

Legacy CLOVER is reported separately and included in the primary
weed response. UNKNOWN BRASSICA and UNKNOWN DICOTS are retained
as unclassified vegetation and excluded from the primary response.

```{r other-components}
other_summary <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(location, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Blocks = n(),
    Legacy_g_m2 = mean(legacy_g_m2),
    Unclassified_g_m2 = mean(unclassified_g_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  other_summary,
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Mean legacy-clover and unclassified biomass"
)

save_csv(
  other_summary,
  "legacy_and_unclassified_summary.csv"
)
```

## Classification sensitivity analysis

This supplementary analysis adds unclassified vegetation to the
primary weed response. It evaluates the effect of that specific
classification choice; it does not establish that the unclassified
plants are weeds.

Primary and supplementary results are reported together, without
selecting a classification by its p-value.

```{r classification-sensitivity, results='asis'}
for (loc in locations) {
  cat("\n\n### ", loc, "\n\n", sep = "")

  report_tables(
    results[[loc]]$classification,
    paste(
      loc,
      "- weeds plus unclassified vegetation"
    )
  )
}
```

## Model diagnostics

Inspect residual spread, normal Q-Q plots and influential observations
before interpreting the primary models. Shapiro-Wilk tests are
supplementary and do not establish that all model assumptions hold.

```{r diagnostics, fig.height=6}
for (loc in locations) {
  old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

  plot(
    results[[loc]]$primary$fit,
    which = c(1, 2, 3, 5),
    ask = FALSE
  )

  par(old_par)
}
```

```{r normality-tests}
normality_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(locations, function(loc) {
    test <- shapiro.test(
      residuals(results[[loc]]$primary$fit)
    )

    data.frame(
      Location = loc,
      W = unname(test$statistic),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  })
)

knitr::kable(
  normality_results,
  digits = 4,
  row.names = FALSE
)

save_csv(
  normality_results,
  "weed_residual_normality.csv"
)
```

## Log-scale sensitivity analysis

A separate analysis of natural-log weed biomass is run only when
all plot responses are positive. No constant is added to zeros.
Estimates in these tables are on the natural-log scale.

```{r log-sensitivity, results='asis'}
for (loc in locations) {
  cat("\n\n### ", loc, "\n\n", sep = "")

  z <- results[[loc]]$log

  if (is.null(z)) {
    cat(
      "Log analysis skipped because a plot response was zero.\n\n"
    )
  } else {
    report_tables(
      z,
      paste(
        loc,
        "- natural-log weed biomass"
      ),
      include_means = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

## Interpretation

Primary results concern recorded weed biomass, including legacy
clover and excluding unclassified vegetation.

T1-T4 comparisons in the cover-crop area include the no-crop control;
T2-T4 comparisons in the broccoli area concern mowing schedules.
Differences from T1 cannot be attributed to mowing alone because
planting also differs.

The two sampling protocols are interpreted separately.
A nonsignificant test does not demonstrate treatment equivalence.

Conclusions should consider effect estimates, uncertainty, diagnostics
and both sensitivity analyses. The available cover-crop records do not
establish complete berseem-plus-rye biomass or its treatment response.

```{r save-session-information, include=FALSE}
capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "session_info.txt"
  )
)
```
